text:
maria: quick follow-up on lease behavior we spotted in the admission RFC. small note: long-lived websockets seem to slowly eat soft-lease credit until residual ~0 without eviction. putting a short thread here to decide interface boundary.

raj: can you paste one-line log excerpt?

maria: short tail: [2026-04-02T09:12:00Z] admit stream=s-123 lease=1.0 used=0.007 residual=0.993 
[2026-04-02T09:22:00Z] admit stream=s-123 lease=1.0 used=0.005 residual=0.985 
... 24h later residual ~0.001 and no abort.

dan: sounds like heartbeat/renewal not happening or rounding causes fractional bleed. who should own renewals: admission or edge?

raj: my take: edge should emit cheap renewals (best-effort) and admission owns final decision + abort timestamp. keeps admission authoritative but minimizes RPCs when unnecessary.

sarah: operational tradeoff: renewals increase load; need probation/backpressure feedback so edge can stop renewing when system is tight. also need a max-ttl so sessions don't live forever.

maria: proposal: add PATCH /admit/v1/leases/{id}/renew that is idempotent and returns headers: X-Quota-Probation (0.0-1.0) and X-Quota-Abort-At (iso). Admit response includes X-Quota-Lease-TTL. Renewals are best-effort, limited by max_renewals and total_lifetime.

raj: boundary constraints: renewals O(1) (no heavy DB ops), cheap token accounting (approximate), and a configurable probation_threshold that flips tighter behavior. edge shim will track renewal attempts per stream.

dan: rollout: 2% canary, synthetic long-lived streams, and a failure-mode where renewals are dropped to confirm graceful drain. add tracing tags lease.id and probation.level.

sarah: telemetry I'll add: quota.lease_active_count, quota.renewal_attempts_total, quota.renewal_failures, histogram quota.residual_fraction. Alert if median residual_fraction < 0.03 for 10m.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled lease-renewal/shim -> staging at 2026-04-03T01:00Z

maria: action items: raj=edge shim + renew call, dan=perf harness for long-lived streams, sarah=dashboards & alerts. product FYI: pinging @alex about customer-facing lease semantics (should be backwards compatible but document soft-lease behavior).

raj: will keep logic minimal in edge, include client hint header X-Stream-Idle-Estimate so edge can avoid needless renewals.

dan: will run canary and report: latency/regression and correlation between probation and tail latency.

maria: thanks all. sync tomorrow 9:30 to review telemetry and agree rollback criteria. :thumbsup:
